title: OpenBindings Conformance Fixture
description: JSON Schema describing the format of a conformance fixture file. A file cites either one rule of openbindings.md section 10 (rule, with section "10") or a section whose text answers its tests (section, with no rule). Each test gives a text and whether it conforms.

rule.description: The rule this file covers, as openbindings.md section 10 identifies it. A file that cites a rule has section "10".

section.description: The number of the openbindings.md heading whose text answers the file's tests: "10" for a rule file, otherwise the section the file cites (for example "12").

description.description: Human-readable description of the rule or section, ideally byte-faithful to the spec text.

notes.description: Optional file-level rationale text about the file's coverage in this corpus, e.g. why some test cases are intentionally out of format. Informational; not consumed by harnesses.

coverage.description: If present, marks this fixture as providing partial coverage of its rule. 'positive-only' means the fixture has no discriminating negative cases (typically because negative cases cannot be expressed in the document-level fixture format without per-format harness logic). A fixture marked this way is counted separately in the manifest and does not contribute to a 'complete coverage' claim. Absence means complete coverage.

tests.description: Test cases for this rule or section. Each case bundles an OBI input with whether it conforms.

description.description: Description of what this specific case tests.

document.description: An OBI document embedded as a parsed JSON value, standing for its serialization as UTF-8 JSON text with no byte-order mark, each number at its exact value. Exactly one of document, documentText, or documentBase64 is present.

documentText.description: Exact Unicode text of the input. Preserves duplicate keys and malformed JSON that an embedded JSON value cannot carry. Exactly one input carriage is present.

documentBase64.description: Base64 encoding of the exact bytes of the input. Carries malformed UTF-8 and byte-order marks. Exactly one input carriage is present.

valid.description: true if the text conforms to this specification (it meets every rule of section 10); false if it does not.

violates.description: When valid is false, the minimum set of rules the text violates: it violates at least these, and may violate others.

notViolated.description: When valid is false, rules the text does not violate although it violates another: the rule holds, holds vacuously, or does not apply to the text. The mirror of violates, and disjoint from it.
